# Lockfile fixtures

Generated by the real tools (in 2026-11, on Windows):

- `uv/uv.lock` - `uv lock` (uv 0.11.7) over `uv/pyproject.toml`
- `npm3/package-lock.json`, `npm2/package-lock.json` - `npm install --package-lock-only --lockfile-version 3|2` (npm 11.9.0)
- `pnpm9/pnpm-lock.yaml` - `pnpm install --lockfile-only` (pnpm 10.30.3, lockfileVersion 9.0)

Formats whose tool was not available here (cargo, go, yarn v1, poetry, pnpm v6, requirements) are
small samples that follow the real format (copied from the sibling depaudit-mcp project's fixtures,
which were written against real lockfiles).
